title: AI agents in Algorithmic Electricity Markets: On the Emergence of Tacit Collusion
abstract: arXiv:2608.26896v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As electricity market participants increasingly adopt learning-based agents for their bidding strategies, electricity markets are becoming algorithmic. Evidence from algorithmic markets in other domains shows that tacit collusion can arise purely through independent learning. Moreover, electricity markets are typically oligopolistic and feature repeated interaction among a small number of participants, making them structurally susceptible to non-competitive behavior. In the face of these observations, this paper investigates the hypothesis that tacit collusion may emerge in electricity markets where participants' actions are controlled by autonomous learning-based algorithms. translated_title: 算法化电力市场中的AI代理：关于默契合谋的出现
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26896v1 公告类型：新 摘要：随着电力市场参与者越来越多地采用基于学习的代理来制定竞价策略，电力市场正在变得算法化。来自其他领域算法市场的证据表明，默契合谋可以纯粹通过独立学习产生。此外，电力市场通常是寡头垄断的，并且具有少数参与者之间的重复互动特征，使其在结构上容易受到非竞争行为的影响。面对这些观察，本文研究了以下假设：在参与者行为由自主学习算法控制的电力市场中，默契合谋可能出现。我们将策略性竞价建模为具有不完美公开监测的重复博弈，并使用多代理强化学习来模拟参与者的涌现行为。我们提出了一套多维度的标准（超越与纳什均衡的利润比较），以检测和评估合谋行为的出现。
tldr: 本文通过多代理强化学习模拟电力市场中的算法化竞价，首次系统性地证明并检测了在寡头垄断且重复互动的电力市场中，基于学习的AI代理可能通过独立学习自发产生默契合谋，并提出了超越利润比较的多维检测标准。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates through multi-agent reinforcement learning that tacit collusion can emerge spontaneously from independent learning among AI agents in oligopolistic electricity markets, and proposes multi-dimensional criteria beyond profit comparisons to detect such non-competitive behavior.
